intent_text: Users retained access after forced credential reset; require token/session invalidation boundaries.
evidence_excerpt: Reset flow revoked password hash but did not revoke all active refresh tokens. Support confirmed repeatable access with old session.
root_cause: Session revocation boundary missing in reset path.
corrective_action: Invalidate all refresh/session artifacts on reset and enforce re-auth.

intent_text: Privileged approval path allowed direct state transition without dual control.
evidence_excerpt: Audit log showed approve operation called from internal endpoint lacking policy middleware.
root_cause: Authorization middleware not applied uniformly across admin routes.
corrective_action: Require policy middleware + signed approval chain for all privileged transitions.

intent_text: Rust worker retried transient errors without jitter causing cascading queue pressure.
evidence_excerpt: Queue depth grew 8x during upstream timeout window; retries synchronized on fixed interval.
corrective_action: Apply capped exponential backoff with jitter and idempotent replay boundaries.

intent_text: Go handlers leaked goroutines after client disconnect due missing cancellation propagation.
evidence_excerpt: pprof traces showed goroutines blocked in downstream calls after request context cancellation.
root_cause: Context not propagated through dependency layer.
corrective_action: Thread request context through all downstream calls and enforce timeout budgets.

intent_text: Java service produced partial writes under retryable failure path.
evidence_excerpt: Write A committed before external side effect failed, then retry duplicated write A.
root_cause: Transaction boundary wrapped only subset of use-case steps.
corrective_action: Promote transaction to use-case boundary and add idempotency key enforcement.

intent_text: Legacy PHP endpoint accepted unsanitized payload into templated output.
evidence_excerpt: Escaped output path bypassed in one rendering branch for old route.
root_cause: Inconsistent output encoding policy across handlers.
corrective_action: Centralize validation/encoding middleware and ban direct template interpolation.

intent_text: C++ crash linked to ambiguous pointer ownership across async boundary.
evidence_excerpt: Core dump indicated use-after-free after callback captured non-owning raw pointer.
root_cause: Ownership semantics not explicit at async interface.
corrective_action: Convert to RAII ownership and non-owning view types with lifetime contracts.

intent_text: C parser regression allowed out-of-bounds read on malformed frame.
evidence_excerpt: Fuzz corpus reproduced OOB read in header length branch.
root_cause: Length validation executed after offset arithmetic.
corrective_action: Validate bounds before pointer arithmetic and add fuzz regression gate.

intent_text: Python producer emitted field shape incompatible with downstream parser expectations.
evidence_excerpt: Deserializer errors spiked after deploy; missing enum value guards in producer.
root_cause: Schema evolution path lacked compatibility contract checks.
corrective_action: Introduce versioned schema contract checks and compatibility test matrix.

intent_text: Ruby background jobs duplicated side effects on retry after timeout.
evidence_excerpt: Timeout happened after external send succeeded but before ack persisted.
root_cause: Non-idempotent retry path without operation keys.
corrective_action: Persist idempotency key before external send and enforce dedupe on retry.

intent_text: Migration introduced lock contention and degraded key query plan.
evidence_excerpt: DDL lock held during peak traffic, plus planner switched to sequential scan.
root_cause: Migration window and index strategy not validated against production cardinality.
corrective_action: Add online migration pattern and preflight explain-plan gate.

intent_text: React modal regression trapped keyboard users and broke close semantics.
evidence_excerpt: Accessibility reports showed focus never returned to trigger element on close.
root_cause: Focus management omitted in state transition branch.
corrective_action: Enforce focus return and keyboard escape boundary checks in component tests.

intent_text: Service layer returned inconsistent error envelope breaking client retry logic.
evidence_excerpt: Retry classifier failed when error.code missing from one path.
root_cause: Unconstrained thrown error types bypassed serializer.
corrective_action: Enforce typed error envelope and central serialization boundary.

intent_text: Next.js route served stale auth-sensitive payload after mutation.
evidence_excerpt: Revalidation not triggered for dependent route segment after profile update.
root_cause: Cache invalidation boundary missed dependent tags.
corrective_action: Tag dependent resources and enforce revalidate path in mutation workflow.

intent_text: Webhook replay caused duplicate state transitions in Go consumer.
evidence_excerpt: Duplicate delivery with same event id processed twice under race window.
root_cause: Idempotency check and write not atomic.
corrective_action: Use transactional dedupe write and state transition atomically.

intent_text: Rust-generated schema drifted from TypeScript consumer assumptions.
evidence_excerpt: Client rejected new optional field semantics due stale generated bindings.
root_cause: Contract-generation boundary not part of release gate.
corrective_action: Gate releases on regenerated bindings and compatibility checks.
